privateListingRow.title: Modern Living in the Heart of Bartlett
privateListingRow.description:
Welcome to Junoah Estate, a secure new single-storey residential development located in the sought-after suburb of Bartlett, Boksburg. Designed with modern families and professionals in mind, Junoah Estate offers a seamless blend of comfort, style, and convenience — all within a safe, community-focused environment.

Each home features three spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and open-plan living areas that flow naturally into a private garden with a built-in braai, perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. The kitchen comes fitted with a gas stove and offers a practical, contemporary layout ideal for everyday living. Every unit includes a double garage and premium finishes throughout, ensuring quality you can see and feel.

Optional extras include backup inverter systems and air conditioning units, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalise their comfort and prepare for load-shedding with ease. The estate itself is fully enclosed with 24-hour security, access control, and electric fencing, providing peace of mind for residents and their families.

Beyond the homes, Junoah Estate offers a tranquil private park — an inviting green space for children to play, families to gather, and residents to unwind. Its prime location places you minutes away from top schools, shopping centres, and major transport routes, offering the perfect balance between suburban calm and urban convenience.

With bond and transfer costs included, Junoah Estate makes owning your dream home simpler and more affordable than ever. Whether you’re buying your first property or upgrading to something more refined, Junoah offers a secure, low-maintenance lifestyle in one of the East Rand’s most desirable areas.

privateListingRow.title: Last Few Units available in Junoah Estate
privateListingRow.description:
Discover a new standard of living at Junoah Estate — an exclusive boutique development where modern architecture, premium finishes, and secure estate living come together to create the perfect place to call home.

Designed for those who appreciate both style and simplicity, each residence offers spacious open-plan living, three generous bedrooms, two beautifully appointed bathrooms, a contemporary kitchen with a gas hob, and a double automated garage. Private gardens with built-in braais extend your living space outdoors, making every weekend feel effortless.

Set within a secure, access-controlled estate, Junoah Estate delivers the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour security while fostering a welcoming community atmosphere. A beautifully landscaped private park provides the perfect space for children to play, neighbours to connect, or simply to enjoy the outdoors.

Located in the highly desirable suburb of Bartlett, residents are just moments from leading schools, shopping centres, restaurants, medical facilities, and major transport routes, placing everything you need within easy reach.

With bond and transfer costs included, Junoah Estate offers exceptional value and a rare opportunity to invest in a brand-new home that combines quality craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location. Whether you're purchasing your first home, growing your family, or looking to downsize without compromise, Junoah Estate is designed for the way you live today, and tomorrow.
